hakka_share_by_county.source: 客家委員會 全國客家人口基礎資料調查研究 (2004, 2008, 2010/11, 2014, 2016, 2021 reports); 2010 county figures from report 附表A-5/A-6; 2016 & 2021 from 110年報告 表3-2
hakka_share_by_county.unit: % of population (pct) and estimated persons (count), by county

2010.survey: 99年至100年全國客家人口基礎資料調查研究 (fieldwork Nov-Dec 2010, n=65,566; by county of residence)

2014.survey: 103年度臺閩地區客家人口推估及客家認同研究 (n=78,174)

2016.survey: 105年度全國客家人口暨語言基礎資料調查研究 (by county of household registration)

2021.survey: 110年全國客家人口暨語言基礎資料調查研究 (by county of household registration)

2004.definition: pre-客家基本法: 單一自我認定 / 多重自我認定
2004.survey: 93年全國客家人口基礎資料調查研究 (n=37,693)

2008.definition: pre-客家基本法: 多重自我認定 (main definition in 2008)
2008.survey: 97年度全國客家人口基礎資料調查研究 (n=51,803)

hakka_share_by_county.notes: 客家基本法 definition (Hakka blood or descent AND self-identifies as Hakka) exists only from the 2010/11 survey on; 2004 and 2008 use single/multiple self-identification (not comparable; 2008 county shares under 多重自我認定 are in hakka_multi_self_id_by_county). 2010 counts are survey estimates in thousands x1000 by county of residence on the five-municipality boundaries (桃園縣 relabelled 桃園市). 2014 county basic-law shares not published in the reports retrieved (2014 report on hakka.gov.tw not downloaded). Island counties (澎湖, 金門, 連江) have tiny samples; the 2021 report warns not to compare them. 2004 national figures from the council's open-data description (the council's DTST20171200004.csv gives different re-estimated 2004 values: single 285.9萬, multi 441.2萬). hakka.gov.tw PDFs downloaded fine on first try.

hakka_multi_self_id_by_county.unit: % of residents self-identifying as Hakka (multiple identification allowed), by county of residence
hakka_multi_self_id_by_county.notes: Comparable across 2008-2016 (basic-law definition not available for 2008). 2008/2010 on post-2010 municipality boundaries (merged 臺中市/臺南市/高雄市 rows used; 桃園縣 relabelled 桃園市). Island counties have very small samples.

mainlander_share_by_county.source: NOT the 1956/1966 census (unavailable). Proxy: 客家委員會 全國客家人口基礎資料調查 single self-identified main ethnic group (單一自我認定主要族群) by county of residence — 2010/11 report 附表A-7, 2016 report 附表A-5, 2021 report 附表A-5
mainlander_share_by_county.unit: % of residents (all ages, telephone survey weighted to population) by self-identified group
mainlander_share_by_county.notes: 1956 戶口普查 and 1966 census county tables of 本省籍/外省籍 could not be found online from any official source (主計總處/內政部/ndc/data.gov.tw); search only located catalogue records and secondary citations (e.g. ~13% non-Taiwan-province incl. ~270k unregistered soldiers in 1956) — not used. Household-register 籍別 was abolished in 1992. The survey 'mainlander' = 大陸各省市人 (self-identification, not birthplace/籍貫); 2010 hakka includes 大陸客家人 (0.5% nationally). 'taiwanese_only' = respondents insisting on '臺灣人'. Island counties have small samples (連江 n<=102).

indigenous_population_by_county.source: 內政部 內政統計查詢網: 原住民人口─按區域別分 (c0110501, year-end) and 土地面積、戶數與人口數 (c0110101) for denominators; tribes: 內政部戶政司 現住原住民人口按性別、身分、原住民族別分 (村里 level, summed)
indigenous_population_by_county.unit: persons at year-end; pct = % of county/national registered population
indigenous_population_by_county.notes: Coverage 1995-2025 (MOI series starts 民國84年); 1990-94 and earlier not found in the MOI query system. Counties on current boundaries (MOI back-casts merged municipalities). mountain/plains = 山地/平地原住民 legal status. by_tribe is year-end 2015 (104年12月), 2021 (110年12月), 2025 (114年12月); '尚未申報' = tribe not declared. The jump of ~22.6k in 2024 and ~17.8k in 2025 is far above earlier ~5-6k/yr growth; it coincides with the 2024 amendment of 原住民身分法 widening status for children of mixed marriages (cause inferred, not stated in the source table).

foreign_spouses.source: 內政部移民署 各縣市外裔、外籍配偶人數與大陸(含港澳)配偶人數 (cumulative since Jan 1987, Dec files); 內政部 內政統計查詢網 結婚人數按國籍分 (c0140102) and 出生人數按生母原屬國籍 (c0120102)
foreign_spouses.notes: cumulative_stock = all foreign/PRC spouses who registered/applied since 1987-01 (includes those later naturalised, divorced or deceased; PRC counts = applications received); year-end 2015-2025 only — 2007-2014 Dec files on immigration.gov.tw return 404. new_per_year_marriages = persons marrying in the year by nationality (registered marriages, 2004-2025; ~1 non-ROC person per mixed couple, includes foreign husbands); 1998-2003 not in the MOI query system. Year-on-year differences of the cumulative stock approximate new spouses per year. births_by_mother_nationality 2004-2025 (by registration); 1998-2003 published by 戶政司 but not retrieved. Big jump in cumulative stock in 2023 (+14.7k) reflects post-COVID backlog of PRC/foreign spouses.

migrant_workers.source: 勞動部 勞動統計年報 2025 表13-2 引進移工在臺人數－按工作內容分 & 表13-3 按國籍分 (1996-2025); 1992-1995 from 年報 表13-1 (2014 and 2024 editions)
migrant_workers.notes: industry = 產業移工 (manufacturing, construction, agriculture/fishing crew, etc.); social_welfare = 社福移工 = caregivers (看護工) + domestic helpers (家庭幫傭). Through 2014 industry/social_welfare include workers whose permit lapsed (incl. missing workers); from 2015 those are split out as invalid_permit and NOT allocated by nationality/sector. 1992-1995 social_welfare computed as total minus industry; nationality split only from 2000. 1991 (first year of the programme) not in the tables retrieved. 'Other' nationalities (Malaysia, Mongolia) negligible. 2015-2024 figures as revised in the 2025 yearbook.

new_immigrant_children.source: 教育部統計處 新住民子女就讀國中小人數分布概況統計 (106學年度 report, series 93-106學年) + open data 104-114學年新住民子女就讀幼兒園及國中小學生人數 (104_114edu_A_1_9.csv)
new_immigrant_children.unit: students in elementary + junior high (國中小) whose father or mother is foreign/PRC/HK/Macau-born; key = western year in which the school year starts (93學年 = 2004)
new_immigrant_children.notes: 2004-2017 counts and % of all elementary/junior-high students from the 2017 report; 2018-2025 counts from open data (no % — total enrolment not in that file). Open-data totals differ slightly from the report for overlapping years (e.g. 2017: 181,456 vs 181,301); report values kept. by_parent_nationality (2015-2025) = original nationality of the immigrant parent, elementary+junior high. Kindergarten counts exist only for some years and are omitted.
